title: CloudQuery PostgreSQL Source Plugin Spec
description: Configuration schema for the cq-source-postgres CloudQuery source plugin.

connection_string.description: Connection string to connect to PostgreSQL. Supports URL format (postgres://...) and DSN format (key=value pairs). See pgxpool documentation for full syntax.

pgx_log_level.description: Log level for pgx database driver events.

cdc_id.description: If set to a non-empty string, enables CDC mode via PostgreSQL logical replication. Must be unique across all sources targeting the same database.

rows_per_record.description: Number of rows to pack into a single Apache Arrow record during sync.

destination_table_name.description: Template for destination table names. Supports placeholders: {{TABLE}}, {{UUID}}, {{YEAR}}, {{MONTH}}, {{DAY}}, {{HOUR}}, {{MINUTE}}. At least one of {{TABLE}} or {{UUID}} is required. Dynamic time-based placeholders are not allowed when cdc_id is set.
